# Skyboxes & space backdrops

For the cockpit-window space view and planet backdrops. The sky is currently a
procedural shader (`shaders/space_sky.gdshader`); a panoramic HDRI can replace or
augment it via a `PanoramaSkyMaterial`.

**Sources:**
- **Poly Haven** space/night HDRIs — CC0, commercial OK, no login:
  https://polyhaven.com/hdris/skies
- **Blockade Labs Skybox AI** (text → 360° space skybox):
  https://skybox.blockadelabs.com — ⚠️ the **free tier is CC-BY-NC (NOT for
  commercial use)**; a **Pro** plan is required for a commercial license. Since
  The Risen targets IGF, only use paid-tier exports here.

See `docs/ASSET_SOURCES.md` for details.
